page.layout: One printed page. Top: decorative fleuron border. Then full-width title block in capitals and italics (dedication heading). Below, main text in two-line-indented paragraph with large woodcut initial N at left. Faint show-through of the reverse page visible in the background and at the right margin and bottom; not transcribed. No running head, no page number, no marginal notes.

main_text.head: REVERENDISSIMO IN CHRISTO PATRI, JACOBO VSSERIO, ARCHIEPISCOPO ARMACHANO, TOTIUS HIBERNIÆ PRIMATI, GERARDUS & ARNOLDUS BOTII, S.P.D.
main_text.p: NEque rem insolentem facimus, Amplissime Præsul, qui librum hunc, jam alterius Illustrissimi Herois nomini à nobis inscriptum, tuo quoq; dicamus; siquidem in promtu sunt exempla multorum ac sapientum virorum, qui idem factitarunt: & justissimam habuimus causam, quare ita nobis faciundum existimaremus. Quum enim plurima maximaq; in nos beneficia contuleris, & quidem alterum quoq; nostrûm ante aliquot annos honorificis conditionibus in Hiberniam evocatum (longè aliud iter tunc, atq; in Patriam reditum meditantem) prolixè admodum habueris, atq; propensissimo animo, omnibusq; veræ ac summæ benevolentiæ indiciis exinde jugiter prosecutus sis: committere non potuimus, quin hoc saltem gratitudinis nostræ monimentum extare vellemus, atq; publicè, quantum tibi deberemus, testatum facere. Neq; verò alienum à te videri potest hoc opus, qui tantus es in Philosophia quoque

page.notes: The initial N is a large woodcut initial, joined to the first word as "Neque". Faint show-through from the reverse page (partly legible Latin lines at the right and bottom, e.g. "...Iulij... Anno Christi 1613") was deliberately not transcribed. The word "quoque" at the end is set on the right, below the last line, and is printed there as the final word; it is kept as the last word of the paragraph.
